image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a vintage, heavily rusted cast-iron sad iron (flatiron) resting on a textured purple fabric surface. The iron features a solid, looped metal handle attached to the top of a thick, wedge-shaped body. The soleplate has a distinctive scalloped or wavy edge design near the front/top opening, rather than a smooth modern triangular shape. The surface is pitted and corroded, indicating age and lack of use. No power cord is visible, consistent with a stove-heated antique model.
